case.pattern_description: This undocumented fraud pattern involves repeated online micro-charges of under $6 spread over several weeks that are too small to trip standard detection thresholds and are never followed by larger purchases. The activity affects card C12975-K2 belonging to customer C12975, as well as seven other connected customer cards displaying the same pattern without prior micro-charge habits. The fraud was uncovered on 2017-01-26 when customer C12975 disputed online transaction 3660260 for $2.90, leading investigators to uncover coordinated low-value charges across multiple accounts.

case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C12975 disputed online transaction 3660260 on card C12975-K2. Key findings show that the slow micro-charge pattern appeared on 7 other customers' cards with no micro-charge habit in the 30 days up to 2017-01-26, involving charges too small to cross thresholds repeated across customers, and card C12975-K2 already has 1 confirmed fraud closed case. The overall verdict is fraud with a fraud probability of 0.97. Final actions taken are to block the card, create a case, file a report, monitor connected cards, and escalate the matter to an analyst.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report concerns unauthorized activity conducted on visa debit card C12975-K2, which belongs to customer C12975. Between 2017-01-05 and 2017-01-26, an unauthorized party initiated 6 fraudulent transactions totaling $23.99 on the customer's card. The activity was conducted through an online channel under product code C, originating from billing regions 191 and 337. The initial five transactions occurred on 2017-01-05 at 11:33 for $3.51 (transaction 3660255), 2017-01-07 at 10:03 for $5.18 (transaction 3660256), 2017-01-14 at 14:57 for $2.66 (transaction 3660257), 2017-01-18 at 14:42 for $4.75 (transaction 3660258), and 2017-01-22 at 13:22 for $4.99 (transaction 3660259). Device data was captured exclusively for transaction 3660259 as rv:11.0 | | ie 11.0 for desktop |, while all other transactions had no device recorded. The final transaction, flagged transaction 3660260, was executed on 2017-01-26 at 15:09 for $2.90 in billing region 337. Regarding transaction 3660260, the cardholder reported the disputed transaction to the bank and denied making it. The unauthorized scheme was carried out using small online charges of a few dollars spread over several weeks that were never followed by a larger purchase. This activity matches none of the documented fraud typologies. The activity is considered suspicious because the same slow micro-charge pattern appeared across 7 other customer cards during the same timeframe, specifically cards C00348-K1, C01525-K2, C02851-K2, C05083-K1, C06139-K2, C09471-K2, and C12982-K1. Additionally, card C12975-K2 was previously associated with confirmed-fraud closed case CC-4890.
